name: Filter and paginate a small catalogue API
prompt: Implement select_items(records, query) in catalog.py for the existing service.py HTTP server. Run python service.py --port 0 --data records.json to start; its first stdout line reports the assigned port. GET /api/items accepts category (exact match; unknown categories return no results), offset (default 0, integer 0..1000), limit (default 2, integer 1..5). query contains lists of strings from parse_qs with blank values retained. Reject unknown/repeated parameters, blank values, non-ASCII/non-digit integers, negative/out-of-range values by raising ValueError (HTTP 400). Sort by string id ascending, filter before slicing, and return {items,total,offset,limit}, where total is the filtered count before slicing. Never mutate records. Preserve GET /health and unknown-path 404 behavior. Submit only catalog.py; the evaluator uses its own unchanged service wrapper and data.
